description: One child has a general anaesthetic of eight hours and twenty minutes with a heart rate recorded every ten seconds, three thousand readings in all.

expectations.query: SELECT a.duration_minutes FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001431'

expectations.says: All three thousand heart rates are written, and each points at the anaesthetic and falls within its times.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings, SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_datetime BETWEEN a.start_datetime AND a.end_datetime THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.anaesthetic a ON a.anaesthetic_id = m.measurement_event_id JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001431' AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3027018
